intro: Explore Paphos on the west coast of Cyprus: the harbour, UNESCO-listed archaeological sites, beaches, local food and day trips to Coral Bay, the Akamas Peninsula and traditional villages. Save your plans, memorable visits and photos on this device.

areas.name: Kato Paphos
areas.description: Harbourfront, promenade, archaeological sites and seafront cafés.

areas.name: Paphos Old Town (Ktima)
areas.description: Traditional streets, municipal market area, galleries and local cafés.

areas.name: Coral Bay
areas.description: Popular sandy beach and resort area north of Paphos.

areas.name: Chloraka
areas.description: Coastal neighbourhood between Paphos and Coral Bay.

areas.name: Geroskipou (Yeroskipou)
areas.description: Traditional village known for local sweets and its historic church.

areas.name: Peyia
areas.description: Hillside village above Coral Bay with sea views and local tavernas.

attractions.name: Paphos Archaeological Park
attractions.description: UNESCO-listed ancient mosaics and ruins; check opening times and ticket prices.

attractions.name: Tombs of the Kings
attractions.description: Impressive rock-cut Hellenistic and Roman tombs; bring water and sun protection.

attractions.name: Paphos Harbour and Castle
attractions.description: Walk the harbourfront and view the medieval castle; check admission for entry.

attractions.name: Agia Kyriaki Chrysopolitissa
attractions.description: Historic church and archaeological remains including the site traditionally associated with St Paul.

attractions.name: Paphos Old Town
attractions.description: Explore restored streets, shops and local cafés.

attractions.name: Aphrodite’s Rock (Petra tou Romiou)
attractions.description: Famous coastal viewpoint; swimming conditions can be hazardous.

attractions.name: Sea Caves near Peyia
attractions.description: Scenic coastal viewpoint; stay away from unstable cliff edges.

transport.name: Paphos International Airport
transport.description: Airport serving the Paphos area; check bus and taxi options.

transport.name: Paphos public buses
transport.description: Local buses serve the harbour, Old Town and Coral Bay; check current routes and timetables.

transport.name: Intercity buses
transport.description: Check current services to Limassol, Nicosia and other towns.

transport.name: Licensed taxis
transport.description: Agree the fare or confirm meter use before travel.

transport.name: Car hire
transport.description: Cyprus drives on the left; check insurance, parking and road conditions.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: Harbourfront is walkable; archaeological sites can be hot and exposed.

useful.name: Currency
useful.description: Euro (€); check exchange rates and card fees.

useful.name: Travel documents
useful.description: Check current UK passport and Cyprus entry requirements before departure.

useful.name: Languages
useful.description: Greek and Turkish are official languages; English is widely spoken in tourist areas.

useful.name: Driving
useful.description: Drive on the left. Observe local speed limits and parking rules.

useful.name: Time zone
useful.description: Cyprus is normally two hours ahead of the UK.

useful.name: Summer heat
useful.description: Carry water, use sun protection and avoid strenuous walks at midday.

useful.name: Beach safety
useful.description: Follow beach flags and lifeguard advice; conditions can change.

useful.name: Northern Cyprus
useful.description: Border crossings and insurance can involve additional rules; check official advice.

beaches.name: Coral Bay
beaches.description: Popular sandy beach with seasonal facilities; check lifeguard information.

beaches.name: Municipal Baths Beach
beaches.description: Central swimming area near the harbour; rocky access in places.

beaches.name: Alykes Beach
beaches.description: Small beach near the Kato Paphos hotel area.

beaches.name: Faros (Lighthouse) Beach
beaches.description: Beach near the archaeological park; sea conditions can be rough.

beaches.name: Geroskipou Beach
beaches.description: Beach area east of central Paphos with facilities in season.

beaches.name: Lara Beach
beaches.description: Remote protected turtle nesting area; respect restrictions and avoid disturbing wildlife.

markets.name: Paphos Old Town market area
markets.description: Explore local shops, crafts and souvenir stalls; opening varies.

markets.name: Geroskipou sweets
markets.description: Look for locally made loukoumi (Cyprus delight).

markets.name: Supermarkets and essentials
markets.description: Find groceries and travel supplies in town and resort areas.

nightlife.name: Paphos Harbour evenings
nightlife.description: Seafront restaurants, bars and evening strolls.

nightlife.name: Kato Paphos bars
nightlife.description: Lively bars and music venues; check opening hours.

nightlife.name: Coral Bay evenings
nightlife.description: Restaurants and bars around the resort strip.

nightlife.name: Old Town dining
nightlife.description: Relaxed tavernas and cafés away from the seafront.

family.name: Paphos Zoo
family.description: Animal attraction near Peyia; check current opening, prices and animal welfare information.

family.name: Coral Bay
family.description: Sandy beach day; supervise children and follow lifeguard advice.

family.name: Harbour boat trips
family.description: Check seasonal sailing schedules, weather and operator safety.

family.name: Paphos Aphrodite Waterpark
family.description: Seasonal water park; check height restrictions and tickets.

family.name: Archaeological mosaics
family.description: Explore ancient history; bring hats and water.

dining.name: Cypriot meze
dining.description: Sample small dishes in a local taverna; confirm prices and portions.

dining.name: Old Town tavernas
dining.description: Traditional Cypriot dishes and local atmosphere.

dining.name: Fresh seafood
dining.description: Ask about the catch and price before ordering.

dining.name: Halloumi and local specialities
dining.description: Try halloumi, souvlaki and local sweets.

daytrips.name: Akamas Peninsula
daytrips.description: Protected landscapes and walking routes; check access and avoid unsafe off-road driving.

daytrips.name: Blue Lagoon boat trip
daytrips.description: Boat excursions commonly depart from Latchi; check weather and operator.

daytrips.name: Polis and Latchi
daytrips.description: Harbour, beach and tavernas north of Paphos.

daytrips.name: Troodos villages
daytrips.description: Mountain villages and scenery; allow time for winding roads.

daytrips.name: Limassol
daytrips.description: City day trip with marina, old town and museums.

mapPlaces.name: Tombs of the Kings
mapPlaces.description: Tombs of the Kings, Paphos, Cyprus
